sources.supports: Abilities, stats, moveset, and lore in the Pokémon video game series

Mewtwo: Psychic type, Pressure/Unnerve, base stats total 680 (Sp. Atk 154, Speed 130), 2.0 m; weak to Bug, Ghost and Dark; Pokédex: created by gene splicing and DNA engineering, most savage heart among Pokémon. Mega Mewtwo X: Psychic/Fighting, Steadfast, Attack 190, 2.3 m, weak to Flying, Ghost and Fairy, muscles enhanced by psychic power. Mega Mewtwo Y: Psychic, Insomnia, Sp. Atk 194, Speed 140, 1.5 m, weak to Bug, Ghost and Dark; mental power can smash a skyscraper with a mere thought (Let's Go entry).

sources.supports: Ness's abilities, PSI moveset, and role in EarthBound
PSI Rockin is Ness's signature offensive PSI, only in EarthBound; levels α (8), β (22), γ (49), Ω (75); hits all enemies (Ω 320-960 damage); PP cost 10 to 98; only Ness learns it.

Ness learns Teleport α (from a monkey in Dusty Dunes Desert) and β (after his nightmare in Magicant); the user runs until top speed then reappears at a previously visited place; colliding first makes it fail and still costs PP.
